_about: Owner calls on tidal candidates (decisions.md '2026-10-27 — tidal calls'), read by pipeline/tools/audit/tidal_triage.py triage. A decided candidate is class 'owner-decided'. No curated writes: the candidate's proposed boundary already sits where the owner says; this records the call. T166 (owner 2026-10-28): the proposals (pipeline.regs.review.proposals) read each call as a Place y tidal mark at the candidate's proposed point, or at `anchor` when the call names the place itself; a later Tidal-tab mark on the same candidate wins.
